method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi and read each ask page in full (listening 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 20, 21, 22; composing 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 12, 14, 16) and every page filed without asks on contact sheets. Zoomed with PyMuPDF clips at 350-400 dpi wherever a character was in doubt: the Q1 Excerpt 2 chord row (boxed B♭, X label), the Q5 lead-in ("Irish Music.", "A."), the page-16 "B" (no full stop), "Aural Skills" (no full stop), the en dashes in "bars 1–5" / "bars 1–4", the superscripts in AA¹BB¹, and the drawn flat / sharp in "E♭ major" / "F♯ minor". Cross-check: rebuilt every file string, character for character, by concatenating whole printed lines of the text layer (spans in the OpusTextStd music font mapped b→♭, #→♯; spans flagged superscript mapped 1→¹; question labels such as "(a)" stripped; runs of spaces, tabs and the em space after composing bullets collapsed). All 134 strings rebuild exactly from printed lines in printed order, so every apostrophe (’ U+2019 throughout), dash, sign and superscript matches the page; joiners ("\n• " only before printed bullets, " • " between printed composing bullets, a space or "\n" elsewhere, "□ " before tick-box options) were checked against the renders. Verdicts rest on the renders. The file has no readFromPage entries, so none were checked.
